question: Who among the following scientists discovered free living cells in pond water for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anton Van Leeuwenhoek**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Anton Van Leeuwenhoek** was the first scientist to discover free-living cells in pond water.
 
• He is often referred to as the "Father of Microbiology" due to his pioneering work in the field.
 
• Leeuwenhoek's observations of microorganisms were made possible by his skill in creating powerful microscopes.
